tvShow.name: Star Wars: Maul - Shadow Lord
tvShow.overview: After the Clone Wars, Maul plots to rebuild his criminal syndicate on a planet untouched by the Empire.

episodes.name: Chapter 1: The Dark Revenge
episodes.overview: In the criminal underworld of Janix, Maul enacts a plan to consolidate his power.

episodes.name: Chapter 2: Sinister Schemes
episodes.overview: Maul seeks to enlighten his new prisoners while Lawson pursues him.

episodes.name: Chapter 3: Whispers in the Unknown
episodes.overview: As Maul's plans come together, Devon considers her options.

episodes.name: Chapter 4: Pride and Vengeance
episodes.overview: A confrontation between Lawson and Maul threatens everyone.

episodes.name: Chapter 5: Inquisition
episodes.overview: Captain Lawson faces a sobering new reality.

episodes.name: Chapter 6: Night of the Hunted
episodes.overview: Pushed to their breaking point, our heroes have no choice but to run.

episodes.name: Chapter 7: Call to Oblivion
episodes.overview: As enemies close in, Maul is forced to make a stand.

episodes.name: Chapter 8: The Creeping Fear
episodes.overview: A hasty escape plan proves dangerous, while an isolated Maul regroups.

guest_stars.character: Alien Mechanic / Bully Alien #1 / Bully Alien #2 (voice)
guest_stars.name: Dee Bradley Baker

episodes.name: Chapter 9: Strange Allies
episodes.overview: Trust is tested as newly forged allies navigate the only way out.

episodes.name: Chapter 10: The Dark Lord
episodes.overview: One last test, one last chance to escape and survive.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Set after the events of "The Clone Wars," Maul plots to rebuild his criminal syndicate on a planet untouched by the Empire. There, he crosses paths with a disillusioned young Jedi Padawan, who could be the apprentice he is seeking, that will aid him in his relentless pursuit for revenge.

reviews.author: Joogle83
reviews.content:
Watched  Maul Shadow Lord with Sam Witwer(Battlestar Galactica) as Maul, Vanessa Marshall (Star Wars Rebels) as Rook Kast,  A.J. LoCascio( X-Men 97) as Marrok   , Chris  Diamantopoulos(Silcon Valley) as Vario ,Denis  Haysbert(Justice League ) as Master Eiko-Dio  Daki , Gideon  Adlon(The Craft: Legacy) as Devon  Ishara, Richaed Ayoade(The Bad Guys) as  Two Boots , Steven Blum(The Mandalorian And Grogu, Marvel Rivals)  as Icarus, Sam  Cortlett (Vikings  Valhalla) as  Reb , Stephen Stanton (Star Wars :The Clone  Wars)   as Marg Krim, Charlie Bushnell(Percy Jackson  And The Olympians) as  Rylee Lawson , John Carroll Lynch(The Highway Men) as  Nico  Deemis  ,Wagner  Moura(Puss  In Boots :The Last Wish, The  Secret Agent)  as Captain Brander Lawson , Scott  Whyte(Missing Link) as  Dryden Vos.    

Watched  Maul:Shadow Lord loved it was  a slow burn  Tech Noir/Neo -Noir taking inspiration from Anime 1995's Ghost In The Shell ,Akira  and  Cyberpunk  Edgerunners  it  was  very cyberpunk-esque  as  Janix  is  that  also  amazing dynamic between  Maul  and  Devon, Witwer and Aldon brought also amazing performances from the mentor types Moura contiuned from his epic performance  From Puss  In Boots:The Last Wish    as Captain  Lawson basically  a Deckard/K Type of character  and a better version of  Syril Karn from Andor  also  cool seeing  Haysbert  reprise his role as  Daki  many speculate his from The High Republic  Era  also  a great Jedi Mentor in the vein  of Old Ben Kenobi  as well Yoda From  the Original  Trilogy  Loved  the series didnt pull any punches also a forray into Star Wars adult animation which was awesome . Also The action is very  calculated as well  John Wick-Esque even with Lightsabers. I  think Star Wars is fine post-Andor . Maul  is the Most Iconic  Villains along With Vader . 

   Showrunning by Dave Filoni(Star Wars Ahsoka) & Matt  Michnovertz(Star  Wars  :  Jedi  Fallen Order ), Producing by Athena  Yvette-Portillo (Star Wars:Tales Of The Empire) , based on Star Wars Created By George Lucas, Score By Kevin Kiner(Peacemaker) and The Kiners(Tales Of The Underworld)  Maul Shadow Lord doesnt Pull any  Punches also taking inspiration from  Greats  of  Anime in This  Slow Burn Tech-Noir/Neo-Noir Thriller  8.5/10
